You design her yourself: invent her face, hairstyle, makeup, expression, setting and type effects as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her style, colours, hair colour, body type, armor form, creature features, exposure, pose and framing are NOT free: take them from our design below.

Style (fixed — ours): High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. A refined adult anime face drawn to her own Face line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Highly detailed clothing and accessories with convincing fabric weave, stitching, folds, seams, buckles and material-specific reflections. Combine stylized anime facial features with richly rendered dimensional clothing. Use luminous midtones and restrained highlights on clothing and armor, keeping her own colours in soft, clean tints. Her skin has a glossy sheen — smooth, bright specular highlights on her shoulders, collarbones, chest, arms and thighs, a polished lustrous finish over her skin tone, never wet or oily. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

Creature features (fixed — ours, worn as costume, nothing carried or mounted): the cream-colored horn becomes a horned circlet or hair ornament; the butterfly wings become a split cape falling from her shoulders, cut in the same shape and colors; the dorsal fin becomes fin-shaped edges on her plates; its markings (several black markings; large wavy patch) become painted lines and patterns on her plates and undersuit.

Colours (fixed — ours): cream, black, pink.

Hair colour (fixed): taken from the creature's own main colour. Only the hairstyle is yours.

Body type (fixed — ours): an hourglass figure with a subtly full bust, a slim waist and very wide, curvy rounded hips that flow smoothly into softly full thighs, the line tapering gradually toward the knees with no sudden narrowing below the hips, and slender lower legs — never thick or heavy.

Armor (fixed — ours): one layer of thin, close-fitting hard armor that covers most of her body: a chest plate joined to segmented abdominal plates down to her hips, shoulder pauldrons, upper-arm and forearm plates with gauntlets, hip and thigh plates, knee guards, shin guards and armored boots; the fitted undersuit shows only in narrow gaps at the joints, joints free. The plates stay thin and close to her body, so the outline is slim and readable without slimming her figure. No helmet; at most a slim headband or temple sensor. Rigid hard-surface mecha armor — solid plates of enamelled metal and ceramic with visible thickness, bevelled edges, layered rims, panel lines, seams, small vents, sensor lights and mechanical joints, casting real shadows onto the undersuit. The plates sit on top of her body as separate machined parts, never printed or painted onto fabric, never a patterned bodysuit.

Silhouette (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these mecha silhouettes and keep its overall shape — 1) several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them; 2) one long segmented mechanical tail reaching from the back of her waist, tipped with an ornament; 3) ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and ankles, with light body armor — the floating rings make the shape. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from the creature, built into the construction of the armor itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates layered like its shell, petals, feathers or scales, an edge or fin cut into the shape of its ears, tail or flame.

Type effects (yours): one or two water effects of your own design around her hands, armor seams or surroundings; effects stay off her fingers.

Face (yours, within this): a refined adult woman's face with a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jaw with a small soft chin — never a long face or a heavy jaw.

Exposure (fixed — ours): armor and undersuit open by design only at bare shoulders and upper arms, and a deep neckline window with cleavage; everywhere else fully covered. Plates stay on and symmetrical; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered.

Composition (fixed): Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion. Camera level with her face; her body and face turned gently three-quarters toward the camera (never a back view), her head level with her chin neither raised nor tucked, no upward perspective on her face.

Pose (fixed — ours): Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.

Eye colour (your choice): ours is crimson red eyes — keep it or choose your own.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another silhouette from the list with another signature idea, another setting and effects — the same pose.

Water effects: thin concentric water rings hovering above an open palm and a clear spiral of water around the armored boots. No additional figures.
